rule.condition_1: last event of physical line L and first event of immediately following physical line L+1 have the same exact joint_tuple_id
rule.condition_2: both events belong to the same frozen V78 statement_id
rule.condition_3: both events have the same visible image_owner_id
rule.condition_4: the first occurrence is NONCLOSE and no close event lies between the adjacent occurrences
rule.positive_action: classify the line-final occurrence as ANTICIPATORY_MARGIN_COPY and read the line-initial occurrence once as the single source token
rule.negative_action: read both boundary events independently under their existing V78 statuses
